title: Aerial survey of Wrights Hill, Wellington, 1945
credit: Retrolens / New Zealand historic aerial survey SN373, Run B, Photo 15; original photographer unidentified
altText: Black-and-white vertical 1945 aerial photograph of Wrights Hill Fortress and nearby roads.
caption: Vertical aerial photograph of Wrights Hill Fortress, Wellington, taken on 28 September 1945 from approximately 11,000 feet. Survey SN373, Run B, frame 15.
context: Useful evidence of systematic national aerial surveying and the images later digitised for GIS. The original capture survey and frame are known.
